stemMd: Two trains begin 300 km apart and move towards each other at 70 and 80 km/h. How long until they meet?
explanationMd: Their separation shrinks at 70+80=150 km/h. Dividing 300 by 150 gives 2 hours. Opposite directions towards each other require adding speeds.

distractorRationale.e: This uses an average speed without the combined motion.
distractorRationale.b: This uses the speed difference instead of the closing speed.
distractorRationale.a: This uses only the faster train's speed.
distractorRationale.c: This uses only the slower train's speed.
